## Community Coordinated Modeling Center Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information ( CCMC DONKI )
## Message Type: Space Weather Notification - CME (Solar Orbiter)
##
## Message Issue Date: 2024-06-02T15:02:21Z
## Message ID: 20240602-AL-001
##
## Disclaimer: NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center is the United States Government official source for space weather forecasts. This "Experimental Research Information" consists of preliminary NASA research products and should be interpreted and used accordingly.


## Summary:

O-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-06-01T19:12Z.

Estimated speed: ~1215 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 45 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): -175/-8 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-06-01T19:12:00-CME-001

Based on preliminary analysis by the Moon to Mars Space Weather Analysis Office and heliospheric modeling carried out at NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center, it is estimated that the CME may impact Solar Orbiter.  The leading edge of the CME will reach Solar Orbiter at 2024-06-03T16:23Z (plus minus 7 hours). 

Links to the movies of the modeled event (includes CME: 2024-06-01T19:12:00-CME-001):

http://iswa.gsfc.nasa.gov/downloads/20240601_214200_2.0_anim.tim-den.gif
http://iswa.gsfc.nasa.gov/downloads/20240601_214200_2.0_anim.tim-vel.gif
http://iswa.gsfc.nasa.gov/downloads/20240601_214200_2.0_ENLIL_CONE_timeline.gif
http://iswa.gsfc.nasa.gov/downloads/20240601_214200_2.0_ENLIL_CONE_SolO_timeline.gif


## Notes: 
Analysis of this halo CME is complicated by the simultaneous X1.0 class flare peaking at 2024-06-01T18:36Z from Active Region 13697 on the Earth-facing disk, followed by an M7.3 flare from the same Active Region 13697 peaking at 2024-06-01T19:40Z. It was determined that this CME event (2024-06-01T19:12:00-CME-001) is likely backsided.

SCORE CME typification system:
S-type: CMEs with speeds less than 500 km/s
C-type: Common 500-999 km/s
O-type: Occasional 1000-1999 km/s
R-type: Rare 2000-2999 km/s
ER-type: Extremely Rare >3000 km/s
